properties.name: spring.ai.privacy.processing.max-text-characters
properties.description: Maximum UTF-16 length of one text or boundary payload, or of all texts in one batch analysis.

properties.name: spring.ai.privacy.processing.max-output-characters
properties.description: Maximum UTF-16 output length per transformation, including unchanged text.

properties.name: spring.ai.privacy.processing.max-value-tree-characters
properties.description: Maximum cumulative UTF-16 length of strings, map keys, and numeric representations in a value tree or JSON document.

properties.name: spring.ai.privacy.processing.max-value-tree-nodes
properties.description: Maximum node count in a value tree or JSON document, including containers, scalar values, and map keys.

properties.name: spring.ai.privacy.processing.max-depth
properties.description: Maximum container nesting depth in a value tree or JSON document.

properties.name: spring.ai.privacy.processing.max-analysis-segments
properties.description: Maximum number of independent texts in one batch analysis.

properties.name: spring.ai.privacy.processing.max-result-spans
properties.description: Maximum number of spans collected in one analysis operation.

properties.name: spring.ai.privacy.output.block-exception-message
properties.description: Safe exception message used when BLOCK rejects an output; it is not returned as a synthetic model response.

properties.name: spring.ai.privacy.response-inspection.max-stream-frames
properties.description: Maximum response frames inspected before streaming privacy processing fails closed.

properties.name: spring.ai.privacy.response-inspection.max-characters
properties.description: Maximum text and tool-argument characters inspected per response.

properties.name: spring.ai.privacy.response-inspection.max-media-bytes
properties.description: Maximum known media bytes inspected per response.

properties.name: spring.ai.privacy.response-inspection.stream-idle-timeout
properties.description: Maximum idle interval allowed between response stream frames before privacy processing fails closed.

values.description: Replace detected output values with request-scoped opaque tokens.
Replace detected output values with irreversible typed redaction labels.
Reject the response with a typed privacy exception.
